entities.name: Strongrock
entities.description: A small fortress at the base of Koskun Keep where bandits escort merchants.

entities.name: Koskun Keep
entities.description: Keep at whose base Strongrock lies.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: Leader of the bandits loyal to him.

entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: Thief who hangs out at Strongrock.

entities.name: Joven
entities.description: Thief who hangs out at Strongrock.

relations.note: At the base of the keep.
relations.quote: Strongrock is a small fortress at the base of Koskun Keep , on Ulgrotha .

relations.note: Eron is chagrined at their hanging out at Strongrock.
relations.quote: The thieves Chandler and Joven are known to hang out here, much to Eron's chagrin.
